name: When should I consider getting a GEO website audit?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider getting a GEO website audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a GEO website audit if your business relies on local customers, if you're experiencing a decline in local search traffic, or if you're not appearing in local pack results on Google. It's also beneficial when launching a new location, updating your website, or if competitors seem to be outranking you locally. Proactive audits can identify issues before they significantly impact your local visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an audit if your business targets local customers, your local search rankings are poor, or you're opening a new location.
